title: Team & Users
notes: No relation fields, currency, dates, or outbound messaging in this slice, so those boxes stay N/A. GET /users has no server-side pagination (backend returns a plain array), so Team stays a single-fetch DataTable via ListPage without a real infinite-scroll page loop, and has no themed export — flagging for a future backend change to paginate /users if that's wanted. Login history (own and per-user) is similarly a capped, non-paginated array from the backend, so it renders as a plain DataTable, not a ListPage. Activity log IS backend-paginated and got the full ListPage + infinite scroll + filter dialog treatment. Added usersApi.invite/activate/deactivate/unlock/getLoginHistory/getMyLoginHistory/getSignature/updateSignature and a new activityLogsApi module (list/byUser/byEntity) to wire up every previously orphaned endpoint. Email signature now persists via PUT /users/me/signature (structured fields serialized into an HTML comment for round-trip) instead of localStorage. Removed the profile page's fake password-change form — there is no backend change-password endpoint, so it silently did nothing.
showcaseScript: Invite a user and assign the Sales Manager role
Open the activity log and filter by that user
